title: Generated ledgers: which entry of ledger A does not reconcile with ledger B?
decision: which of five listed entries of ledger A fails to reconcile with ledger B under the written matching conventions, or none

source.name: generator build/gen_ledger_reconcile.py
source.version: gen_v4, 2026-10-08: one name per ledger in introduction and table titles; per-line deduction written on the size for plus and minus figures, marked-channel entries of both signs

licence: generated by the benchmark's script (no third-party text)
skill: match two ledgers under written conventions (reference pairing, sign reversal, date tolerance, split lines, per-line deductions, batch totals) and name the one entry that fails
knobs: entries per ledger 8 / 14 / 22; conventions 3 / 6 / 9 sentences; date tolerance 1-5 days; split, deduction (plus and minus figures) and batch lines; near-miss decoys on the limit
notes: 600 items, 200 per level. Groups of items on one base that differ only in the planted lines of B (same line count): per level 66 groups of three and one group of two (groups of three cannot fill 200 exactly), 201 groups in all; 100 groups are {none, X, Y} (or {none, X}) and 101 are {X, Y, Z} (or {X, Y}), so `none` is the gold of 100 items (33 / 33 / 34 per level). The option order is the same inside a group; every gold position holds 100 items. Options: five entry labels of A (key = label, text 'Entry A07') and `none`. Truth is computed on the structured specification (meta.spec) in integer units. Level-3 batch rule: a combined B line that is short by exactly the amount of one entry of its batch leaves that entry out (written in the state). gen_v4 (2026-10-08): the introduction, the table titles and the conventions name each ledger the same way (cash book / bank statement, purchase ledger / supplier statement, stock system / receiving log, timesheet / client hours log, dispatch register / weighbridge record), and the level-3 deduction sentence says that the B figure is smaller in size by the deduction with the sign reversed, so marked-channel entries now carry plus and minus amounts like all others and still exactly one entry fails. State length 1392 to 6052 characters.

sample.note: a sample of two whole contrast groups (one of level 1, one of level 3) for the tests of this repository; EVALUATION ONLY, never a training source
